name: Product Color Card
description: Product showcase card with an image panel, color swatch selector that swaps the image and accent color, description and details tabs, price with discount badge, and an add to cart button.
contents: Product image panel with optional badge and color strip
Color swatches, price, discount, add to cart button
behavior: Selecting a color swaps the image with a slide-up fade and recolors accents
Tabs switch between description and dimensions with a short fade
Add to cart shows an Added state for 2 seconds and calls onAddToCart

props.name: description
props.default: Hand thrown ceramic with a hand rubbed glaze. Each piece is fired and finished to order.

editableByProps: All text, prices, labels, dimensions, color options and images
Card and image panel background classes

needsCodeEdit.where: h-[300px] class on the img element

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the add to cart success colors
needsCodeEdit.where: style on the cart button using the added state

fixed: Root fills at least the viewport height and centers the card. Override with className using an important modifier such as !min-h-0.
Card uses a dark text-white palette; fonts use the font-sans and font-serif utilities
